summary: Tested /confirmacao page with sessionStorage seed (UF_PROVA=TO, __taxa=R$ 150,00, LOCALIDADE_LOTACAO=Palmas, __vaga_label=Fisioterapeuta, MUNICIPIO_PROVA='Araguatins / TO'). All 3 previously missing fields plus UF mapping are now rendered correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: confirmacao.html is a 1600+ line monolithic static file with heavy inline CSS/JS. Consider extracting the confirmation-render script and mobile overrides into separate files for maintainability.
There is a leading empty <h1> on the page (logo area) before the concurso title h1. Not a bug, but could confuse SEO/a11y tools that expect a single top-level h1.
seed_data_creation: Used sessionStorage.setItem('inscricao_dados', ...) with the exact payload from the review request.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified via playwright on public URL: h1 'CONCURSO DA SECRETARIA DE SAÚDE DO ESTADO DO TOCANTINS (SES/TO)' present and visible above 'Confirmação dos Dados'; #c-valor='R$ 150,00'; #c-lotacao='Palmas'; #c-uf-prova='Tocantins' (mapped from TO); #c-municipio-prova='Araguatins / TO'. Table has data-testid='tabela-confirmacao'. Note: querySelector('h1') returns an empty logo h1 first — always use text match or nth to assert the concurso title.
rca of the issue: Bug already fixed by main agent. dados-inscricao.html saves __taxa/__valor/LOCALIDADE_LOTACAO/MUNICIPIO_PROVA/UF_PROVA into sessionStorage. confirmacao.html reads them and: (a) renders new <h1> with concurso title before 'Confirmação dos Dados' h2; (b) adds 'Valor da Inscrição' row bound to #c-valor with fallback d.__taxa || 'R$ '+__valor; (c) adds 'Localidade para Lotação' row bound to #c-lotacao; (d) UF map includes {'BA':'Bahia','TO':'Tocantins'}. All confirmed rendered.
